privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected air densities are 1.225 kg/m^3 (Sea Level) and 0.900 kg/m^3 (High Altitude). Because wind power is linearly proportional to air density in BEM theory, the expected ratio of High Altitude Max Power to Sea Level Max Power is approximately 0.7347 (0.900 / 1.225). A tolerance of 0.05 is acceptable for the ratio due to potential numerical rounding in the simulation software.
